I am Patrick, former candidate for governor... But, let me tell you something about me that is hard to even fathom.

My mom came from a Midwest family on the poor side of the tracks. She literally grew up having dirt floors and an outhouse. By the time she was 15, she'd gotten married, and had her first child, my eldest biological sister. Over the next few years, she gave birth to my 3 brothers. My brother next to me is 14 years older than I am.

My stepfather, a really nasty man, and my mother were dating. I had no idea that he wasn't my biological sperm donor. They broke up, my mother got pregnant by my biological father. My stepfather came back into her life and threatened biological father, and the rest of the family to keep the secret that I was literally a bastard child.

My mother, who was pregnant with me, wanted a baby girl and a second chance. After I was born, my mother started dressing me as a baby girl. My biological father thought I was a girl, tried to find me, but had nothing to go on. My sister, who was 19-20 years old at the time would come and rescue me from my mother and dress me as a boy.

My own family kept that secret from me, but they were under threat from my stepfather.

As I grew up, my stepfather was violent... I saw him hit my mother when I was 7. He used a black leather belt on me until I got older where he used his fists on me. He knocked me out and my head bounced off a concrete floor. Another time, he'd knocked me down, places his knee on my chest and best the hell out of me. 

I later learned that he was a pedophile and I was the only person out of my entire family to confront him. He'd harmed his sister, my 2 step-sistets and 2 of my nieces. I almost called the police on him because he kept poking me with his cane at 81 years old. The only thing that stopped me was the fact that he wasn't worth going to jail for.

He'd inappropriately touched me, and I hated it, and I nearly kicked him on his junk for it, but I was scared of him. 

My own family, eldest nephew who is 2.5 years older than me, was also very sick... Sexually assaulting his sister's, bullying and beating me.

I was bullied and beaten through school. Physically assaulted a dozen times at my first duty station by those I worked with. My ex who held a knife to me and attempted to run me over that was emotionally, mentally, and physically abusive.

That's just one aspect of my life.

All this trauma from an early age led me down a very bad path of attempting to escape being a man.

Then when we add in 17 times in my life that I shouldn't even be here today? 

Volcanic eruption (Pinatubo).
Typhoon (during Pinatubo aftermath).
Dysentery.
Combined Philippines event (volcano + typhoon + dysentery).
Inside a tornado (2015 Oklahoma I-44 event, truck damaged but upright).
Severe fall.
C. difficile infection.
Multiple assaults (military, off-base, abusive ex).
Nearly being run over by abusive ex.
Nearly a half dozen times she held a knife against you.
Self-harm thoughts / suicidal ideation (dark place in 2023–2024).
Motor vehicle accident.
Fires.
Tornado (separate incident).
Despair (profound emotional lows).
Military incident (additional unspecified or hazing-related).

So, when you accuse me of being something I'm not, nor ever been, I don't play the victim. I am someone who has survived the unimaginable. I am someone who didn't turn out like his abusers. I am a child of the one true God whom I gave my life to I'm the middle of a pasture and healed from the trauma that permeated my life.

I don't owe anyone anything, I owe it all to God. I don't need your permission, acceptance, approval, validation, or anything from anyone. I've gone through most of my life without anyone to help me and lived through things that would break you. And if it weren't for God intervening in my life, I know I wouldn't be here today.

/1

data.raw_text:
LOOK: Fisherfolk in Cavite and Navotas held a simultaneous “tigil-palaot” protest, seeking massive rollback on fuel products.

Fishers’ group PAMALAKAYA said that at least 50% of fisherfolk at a municipal level have stopped fishing for over a month because they can’t earn nor even recover their fuel cost, which has already increased by around 120% since March.

The fisherfolk also denounced the Marcos administration’s “inadequate” response, especially in the rollout of fuel subsidy that is “insufficient, overdue, and selective”. 

PAMALAKAYA said that prior to the oil price shock, a small fisher in Manila Bay used to spend P560 on diesel per fishing trip. Now that the diesel has reached P124 per liter all-time high, fisherfolk have to prepare P1,240 for 10 liters of diesel, a 121% increase. | RH 15 @JecelleRicafort, DZRH News

📸: @pama_pil
